summary: #130144 is a confirmed narrow Telegram rendering defect: the shared, configured progress-line budget is bypassed by Telegram’s fixed 300-unit clipping. A new fix PR is appropriate, but this read-only checkout has neither dependencies nor build output, so required regression validation and Telegram Test Server proof cannot run or be published.

actions.reason: Filesystem access is read-only, so no branch or patch can be created. The checkout is shallow, has no node_modules or dist/entry.js, and lacks the runtime prerequisites for mandatory Telegram Test Server proof; pnpm docs:list also fails because Corepack cannot create its cache on the read-only filesystem.
